name: barcode-stocktake-app
description: Mobile-friendly barcode stocktake app with live counts, offline scanning, and variance reporting.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
